main_text.p: beneficiis, Gen.32.10. Futur. וַתִּקְטֶן Et parum fuit vel vi-sum fuit hoc, 2.Sam.7.19. Hiph. Infinit. לְהַקְטִין Ad mi-nuendum, Amos 8.5.

קָטֹן masc. Parvus, Minor, Minimus: דָּבָר קָטֹן אוֹ גָּדוֹל Rem parvam aut magnam, 1.Sam.22.15. Constr. קְטַן בָּנָיו Minimus filiorum ejus, 2.Paral.21.17. Aff. קַטַנִּי Minimus mews [?], scilicet, digitus, 1.Reg.12.10. Simile vide paulo ante in קטב.

קָטָן masc. Idem; בֶּן קָטָן Filius parvus, 2.Sam.9.12. Aff. מִקְטַנָּם A minimo eorum, Jer.6.13. Plural. נְעָרִים קְטַנִּים Pueri parvi, 2.Reg.2.23. Constr. קַטַנֵּי־אָרֶץ Minima terra, Prov.30.24. Fœmin. עִיר קְטַנָּה Civitas parva, Eccl.9. v.14. Plural. לְיוֹם קְטַנּוֹת Diem parvarum, Zachar.4.10. scil. rerum, Parvorum operum: אֶל־הַקְּטַנּוֹת מִמְּךָ Ad minores te, Ezech.16.61.
קטף Decerpsit, Ezech.17.4. וְקִטַּפְתְּ מְלִילוֹת Et decerpes spicas, Deut.23.25. Niph.Futur. לֹא יִקָּטֵף Non decerpetur, Job.8.12.

קטר Pih. קִטֵּר Adolevit, Suffivit, Suffumigavit, Suffitum, Fumum fecit: Præter. קִטְּרוּ שָׁמָּה Suffitum faciebant illic, 2.Reg.23.8. Particip. לוֹ מְקַטְּרִים Adolentes ei, 2.Reg.18.4. Pyh. Partic. מְקֻטֶּרֶת מוֹר Suffumigata myrrha, Cant.3.6. Hiph. Præt. וְהִקְטִיר עָלָיו Et adolebit super eo, Exod.30.7. Particip. מַקְטִיר Adolens, 1.Reg.3.3. Infinit. וְהַקְטִיר אֹתוֹ Et suffitum adoleri curabat in eo, 1.Regum 9.25. & אֹתוֹ juxta Hebræos & Chaldæum idem est quod עָלָיו. Hoph. Partic. מָקְטָר Suffimentum fiet, Malach.1.11. Potest & Nomen esse, Suffitus. Futur. כָּלִיל הַקְטֵר Prorsus adoletor, Lev.6.22. al.15.
קיטור m. Fumus, Gen.19.28. Exhalatio, Psal.148.8.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms were read at small size and may contain minor errors. "Pyh." (for Pih.) and "mews" (for meus) are copied as they appear on the scan; the latter is marked [?]. The page carries show-through and scan speckle, which were not transcribed.
